snippet.title: Only One Night v2.0.0 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY IT NOW ON STEAM AND ITCH.IO ON FEBUARARY 13TH!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4346810/Only_One_Night/
https://splat-soul.itch.io/only-one-night

Only One Night is a Fnaf Inspired Roguelike taking place in... well Only one night. 
Inspired by One More Night (Roblox), Fnaf, and Binding of Issac.
Instead of Nights, the game starts at 6pm and goes all the way to 6am. After every hour you are able to buy powerups as you try to fend of the creatures of your own Nightmares...
